author: Notalgicular
body:
Hey guys - Notal here with my first Minecraft PvP montage ft. Nexus and Nebula! :D

The title "I play too" is because of people saying to me I hardly ever play and only observe and record rule breakers but here I am! I play too! 

Please give up your time and check out my first serious video and subscribe to make my channel grow!
All you have to do is click this link and click 1 button and it will mean alot to me.


Thanks, Notal!


(https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jejxs7Sm4Z0&feature=youtu.be)
